head: Second Look: a back seat reminder app for parents after every drive
dek: Second Look Reminder is a $4.99 iPhone app that notices when you've been driving and reminds you to check your car after the trip. It was #94 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 26 November.
details: It's made for parents and caregivers and uses driving detection plus reminders you can set up yourself. The listing calls it an extra reminder for busy days or changed routines, and says it adds to safe habits in the car rather than replacing them. It's made by Judith Fuller and came out on 25 November.
where: iPhone (also listed for iPad), App Store, $4.99, with in-app purchases
means: If your routine changes and you worry about forgetting to look in the back seat, this adds a reminder after each drive.
todo: Search "Second Look Reminder" in the App Store; keep your own habit of checking the car too, as the listing says.
thumb_words: SECOND LOOK: CHECK THE BACK SEAT
